nodes.name: .graphify_analysis.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify analysis data used to describe graph structure, communities, and diagnostics.

nodes.name: .graphify_ast.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify's abstract-syntax-tree extraction results for the repository source corpus.

nodes.name: .graphify_detect.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify corpus-detection output for the most recent graph analysis run.

nodes.name: .graphify_extract.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify extraction output that combines structural and semantic graph data.

nodes.name: .graphify_incremental.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify incremental-update state used to identify changed material between graph builds.

nodes.name: .graphify_labels.json
nodes.summary: Stores the human-readable labels assigned to Graphify communities.

nodes.name: .graphify_old.json
nodes.summary: Stores a prior Graphify graph snapshot for comparison during graph updates.

nodes.name: .graphify_semantic.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify semantic-extraction results used to enrich the structural graph with conceptual relationships.

nodes.name: .graphify_semantic_new.json
nodes.summary: Stores newly produced Graphify semantic-extraction records before they are merged into the graph.

nodes.name: .graphify_uncached.txt
nodes.summary: Lists documents that were not served from Graphify's semantic-extraction cache during a graph build.

nodes.name: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Reports Graphify corpus coverage, graph health, communities, high-connectivity nodes, relationships, and benchmark results.

nodes.name: cost.json
nodes.summary: Stores Graphify run cost and token-accounting metadata.

nodes.name: graph.html
nodes.summary: Provides the interactive Graphify HTML visualization for browsing repository nodes and relationships.

nodes.name: graph.json
nodes.summary: Stores the exported Graphify graph containing repository nodes, links, communities, and relationship metadata.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Records the Graphify output manifest and source inventory for the generated graph artifacts.
